what: Mid-sized custom shop. Legacy modernization is one of several offerings (Java, .NET, mainframe).
bio: Kansas City consultancy practice lead. Friendly Midwestern tone — engages on technical merits rather than gatekeeping. Probably came up writing Java/.NET before owning the modernization line. The shop isn't COBOL-pure so they may try to steer the conversation toward Java work — steer back.

abc.a: You're small enough that one tool compressing discovery from weeks to days is the difference between winning and losing the next mainframe bid.
